posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked:
TakeWalker:

Glad I’m not the only GM who has trouble coming up with environment-related things, on the fly or otherwise.

Environment is the part I have the most trouble coming with. At least ahead of time while building the issue. Everything else is very story-related (the villain has a story, the adventure has a story), but the Environment doesn’t. At least in the planning stage / for me. During play, working off my players and what they’re doing, I can usually come up with some good stuff. But while building the adventure? Not so much.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
I struggle with environments, too. Not every fight has to be in some interesting setpiece location, but having no environment shouldn’t be the default. It’s hard to not to have a ton of scenes in cities with collapsing power lines, sewers, and bystanders getting in the way all the time.

Godai:

Any bets on the mystery boss(es)? They definitely made it sound like the three you have to fight are already themed to their unique drivers.

The Order of the Simple Machine leaps immediately to mind. They’re a Paradigms villain, they’re in Rook City, and there are 3 main lieutenants. The Organization is also possible.
